evidence.author: akshatmittal
evidence.title: Update scripts for smoother local + live execution

concerns: No evidence that the PR was merged into the repository's default branch; the diff alone does not indicate merge status.
CI results are not included; we cannot verify that all CI checks are passing on the merged commit.
The added `DeployLocalV4` script is gated to chainId 31337 (local only) and does not address live‑network reliability directly.
The README change removes the `--disable-code-size-limit` flag, which may be required for successful deployment on some live networks.
`foundry.toml` now contains duplicate `bytecode_hash` entries (one removed, one added) which could cause configuration errors.
Modifications to `BaseScript` change labeling and deployer logic; it is unclear if these changes preserve existing script behavior for live networks.
review.summary: The diff updates files in the `script/` directory and adds new helper contracts that aim to improve local‑only deployment, but the information provided does not confirm that the pull request was merged into the default branch or that CI passes on the merged head. Consequently, we cannot determine definitively that all acceptance criteria are met.

rubric.description: Deterministic acceptance rules. The pass/fail decision is made here, never by the LLM.

llm.note: The LLM may veto (verdict=inconsistent) but cannot pass a deliverable that fails a rule, and never sets an amount or recipient.

rubric.note: Path requirements are per grant (grants.json: requiredPathGlobs), committed by the DAO before the audit.

systemPrompt:
You are an independent auditor for a DAO grant program.
You receive a request for proposals (RFP) and the full diff of a merged pull request submitted as the deliverable.
Decide whether the diff plausibly fulfils the RFP's stated deliverable and acceptance criteria.
You do not decide payment amounts or recipients and must not comment on them.
Report every concrete concern you notice; downstream rules filter them.
Answer "inconsistent" only when the diff clearly does not deliver what the RFP asks for.
Answer "insufficient_evidence" when the diff alone cannot show it either way.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"verdict": "consistent" | "inconsistent" | "insufficient_evidence", "summary": string, "concerns": string[]}.
